blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The 55-point rout of listless Macau in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Tuesday allowed TNT to give some of its players the chance to have minutes that they rarely get. And veteran guard Jio Jalalon took advantage of that opportunity, resulting in only his third career triple-double. Jalalon finished with 11 points, 13 rebounds, and 11 assists in the Tropang 5G’s 142-87 victory at Ninoy Aquino Stadium.
